title: Bongo problems
summary: Four checks in order. Most problems end at step 1 or 3.

la: Walk students through the Bongo checks
lc: Turn Bongo on in a D2L course

nodes.text: On an iPad? Chrome, desktop site

sections.title: 1. iPads: Chrome, desktop site
sections.text: Blank screen or video won't load on an iPad: open the lab in **Google Chrome**, tap the menu, choose **Request Desktop Site**.

sections.title: 2. Is Bongo turned on?
sections.text: No Bongo link in the course, or a "tool unavailable" message: Bongo isn't turned on for that course yet. Tell the coordinator; you can't fix this one.

sections.title: 3. Browser checks
steps: Turn off ad and pop-up blockers.

sections.title: 4. Still broken
sections.text: The student emails {email} with their name, class and section, and a screenshot of the error.
sections.note: A technology problem never extends a due date. Lab 0 (the setup check) exists so problems show up in week 1.

sections.title: Coordinator
list: Turn Bongo on in the D2L course
Pass unsolved problems to D2L support
